title: Icing Conditions and Holding Limitations

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Ice and Rain Protection — Airfoil Anti-Ice

abstract: Flight crew limitations applying in icing conditions, covering the definition of icing conditions, holding restrictions with ice accretion and the reduced configuration limits when one side is unavailable.

sections.purpose: States the limitations that apply to the flight crew in icing conditions, including holding and the case where airfoil ice protection is unavailable on one side.
sections.description: Icing conditions exist when the total air temperature is at or below the stated value and visible moisture is present in any form, including cloud, rain, snow, sleet and ice crystals, or when standing water, slush, ice or snow is present on the taxiways or runway. The definition is deliberately wide because the crew cannot see accretion on the outboard leading edge from the flight deck at night, and the visual reference on the wiper post is the only direct indication available. Holding in icing conditions with ice accreted on the airframe is restricted, because the accreted shape changes the stall characteristics and the margin assumed by the flight envelope protection. Where airfoil ice protection is unavailable on one side, the aircraft is restricted from any flight in known or forecast icing, and the dispatch relief in the minimum equipment list is written for that case only. The limitation applies to the whole flight, not only to the portion in icing conditions.
sections.crew_procedure: Before dispatch, confirm from the technical log whether airfoil ice protection is available on both sides. In flight, confirm that the total air temperature and the presence of visible moisture together define icing conditions before making any selection. Where ice is accreted, avoid holding and request a level or routing change. Where protection is unavailable on one side, avoid known and forecast icing for the whole flight and plan an alternate that does not require it.
sections.limitation_note: Airfoil ice protection unavailable on one side: no flight into known or forecast icing conditions. Holding with ice accreted on the airframe: not permitted below the stated speed and configuration. Icing conditions are defined by total air temperature at or below the stated value together with visible moisture in any form, or by contamination on the ground surfaces.

type_data.crew_action: Confirm both sides available before dispatch; avoid known and forecast icing where one side is unavailable.
